disease_info.name: Healthy Leaf
disease_info.description: Vibrant, deep green, well-expanded fronds with normal photosynthetic function, free of chlorosis, necrosis, leaf spots, or fungal blights.
symptoms: Smooth leaf surface without lesions or necrotic margins
treatments: Maintain balanced N-P-K (100:40:140 g per palm per year) fertilization
Ensure regular irrigation during dry months
prevention: Provide adequate spacing (2.7m x 2.7m) to prevent overcrowding
